question:
A concave spherical mirror forms a **virtual, erect** image of a point object placed on its principal axis (Cartesian sign convention). In the first arrangement, the magnification is $m_1=+2$.

The object is then moved **$6\,\text{cm}$ farther from the mirror on the object side** (i.e. $|u|$ increases), and the magnification becomes $m_2=+3$.

Now, starting again from the first arrangement ($m_1=+2$), the object is moved **towards** the mirror by an unknown distance $x$ and the magnification becomes $m_3=+\dfrac{3}{2}$.

The value of $x$ (in cm) is closest to:
